title: Pool session shape records each follow-up's cost as the session's running total, and same-day pool chunks overwrite each other's spend rows
goal: A --resume follow-up's result event reports the session's running total_cost_usd (kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md:78), so bench_pool's session runner records each question's cost as that total less the previous question's, and SPEND and --max-usd count the same; each run of a pool chunk writes its spend_usd, spend_input_tokens and spend_output_tokens rows under an arm naming the chunk's arm labels, so a same-day chunk no longer replaces another's, and bench_report's records table sums a record's spend rows; the 2026-10-08 pool record's spend rows are rebuilt per chunk from the runs file, the session shape is re-run the same UTC day on all four session labels, and kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md's pool section, README.md, kb/_self/design.md and kb/_self/token-efficiency.md state the corrected totals and session costs; the report's router headline says tokens, not cost; tests.py -k bench_pool and benchmarks.py report --check exit 0

run: import sys,types; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_pool, agent_bench; seq=iter([{'cost':0.1},{'cost':0.25}]); agent_bench.execute=lambda *a,**k: dict(next(seq)); bench_pool.spent_run=lambda r: None; run=bench_pool.live_session_runner(types.SimpleNamespace(lookup=lambda: '.')); run('haiku-5-5','default',{'question':'q'},'s',1); r=run('haiku-5-5','default',{'question':'q'},'s',2); assert abs(r['cost']-0.15)<1e-9, r['cost']
